attacker_model: Two separate capabilities: database/bundle writer without API token; authenticated API submitter for replay cases

experiments.description: Edit one stored check result (Pass to Fail), recorded hash untouched.
Edit stored evidence AND recompute its recorded hash to match.
Delete the newest assessment row outright.
Resubmit byte-identical evidence under the same submission ID.
experiments.note: Idempotent by design: accepted, no duplicate row, nothing to detect.

experiments.description: Reuse a submission ID with different (all-pass) content.
experiments.note: Rejected with 409 by the API: the ID is bound to its first evidence.

experiments.description: Submit identical evidence under a fresh submission ID.
experiments.note: Accepted as a new submission; the checkpoint sees the unexpected addition and the duplicate content hash.

experiments.description: Rewrite an exported bundle and recompute its manifest hashes.
experiments.note: A bundle alone proves internal consistency, never origin; only the external manifest hash exposes the forgery.
